items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: me and Louis Hayes see, Ed Thigpen, and Ray Brown.

ctx.x: Join the trio, I said, 'wait a minute, man, what's wrong with you,' 'I said man,' 'what's the matter with Ray Brown?' you know. He said Ray Brown is quitting the trio and he would like for me to join his trio. So, that's right on time man, cause I'm thinking about leaving Cannon. You know what I mean, so I say Damn, Boy, things are working out. I be glad man. I say 'hey, I'll do the best I can.' He say, 'look man, that's all I want you to do, the best you can.' You know what I mean, I say fine. So they had a tour…
